species_skitter_mite.title: Skitter Mite
species_skitter_mite.subtitle: WILDLIFE · Red Reaches
species_skitter_mite.body:
Rust-red mites that strip mineral crust from Red Reaches rock. Harmless alone. Not alone, usually.

BEHAVIOUR: Swarms. When a swarm is broken, the survivors scatter.

HABITAT CHAIN: Reach soil bed · Moss bed · Heat lamp · Scale Anchor.

species_plate_beetle.title: Plate Beetle
species_plate_beetle.subtitle: WILDLIFE · Red Reaches
species_plate_beetle.body:
A slow, heavy grazer of mineral lichen with a carapace like layered slate. Normally docile.

FIELD NOTE: Resonance vibration from Dominion survey pylons agitates the nervous ganglia under the carapace. Remove the source and the herd calms.

HABITAT CHAIN: Reach soil bed · Lichen mat · Heat lamp · Scale Anchor.

species_dust_grazer.title: Dust Grazer
species_dust_grazer.subtitle: WILDLIFE · KEYSTONE · Red Reaches
species_dust_grazer.body:
Long-legged lichen grazers that drift across the plateaus in loose herds.

ECOLOGY: Their droppings seed the lichen that binds plateau soil. Remove the herd and the valley floor begins to blow away. A keystone species.

HABITAT CHAIN: Reach soil bed · Lichen mat · Humidity mister · Scale Anchor.

species_dominion_drone.title: Survey Drone
species_dominion_drone.subtitle: DOMINION ASSET
species_dominion_drone.body:
Autonomous survey and security drone operating under a Dominion extraction permit. Fast, fragile, and armed with a three-shot burst.

WEAKNESS: Heavy impact.

species_augur_rig.title: AUGUR-7 Deepcore Rig
species_augur_rig.subtitle: DOMINION ASSET · Permit 7-K
species_augur_rig.body:
A Thoughtstone extraction rig. Its tuning field resonated with the Ochre Span's foundation and the plate beetles' nervous systems alike.

When overheated, it vents coolant through three exposed vents.

char_aruun.title: Aruun — The Reacher
char_aruun.subtitle: First Ten
char_aruun.body:
BRU-004 · Homeland: The Red Reaches · Knack: Psionic Bond / Kinetic Force.

A Spanwright apprentice turned warrior. During the Red Span disaster he anchored his bonded Thoughtstone mace, Morrow, and carried part of a bridge for eleven minutes. Thousands escaped. Hundreds did not.

He is famous for destruction and wants to be remembered for building. He refuses to call Morrow property.

"Further than you think."

char_cigarra.title: Cigarra — The Oracle Hopper
char_cigarra.subtitle: First Ten
char_cigarra.body:
PSI-017 · Homeland: The Canopy Fold · Knack: Probability Perception.

Raised among the Listening Houses, Cigarra perceives outcomes that have not happened — as noise, not clarity. She let humans classify her as a specimen for months while she learned their language. Then she wrote: I KNOW WHAT YOU ARE DOING.

She refuses to be called an oracle. "A future seen is a future touched."

char_mara.title: Dr. Mara Venn
char_mara.subtitle: Stewardship Coalition
char_mara.body:
Lead physicist and expedition lead. One of the intellectual architects of the Stewardship Coalition, though she dislikes being a symbol.

Principle: access does not create ownership.

"Curiosity always wins. It just usually costs more than people expect."

char_dexter.title: Dexter Mane
char_dexter.subtitle: Human Dominion
char_dexter.body:
Scientist, strategist, expedition architect — and the central figure of the Human Dominion.

He is not a sadist. He believes humanity has been handed the most consequential discovery in its history, and that hesitation may be more immoral than exploitation. He can be right about facts while catastrophically wrong about what those facts permit.

"Morality is a luxury. So is time."

char_mollusk.title: Mollusk — The Weight of Tomorrow
char_mollusk.subtitle: First Ten
char_mollusk.body:
CHR-001 · Homeland: Rainward · Knack: Temporal Inertia.

Mollusk does not stop time; he increases resistance to change. Rescue crews love him. He teaches a doctrine called Borrowed Seconds: every second he creates is a debt. Use it.

His love of forklifts remains inexplicable and unquestioned.

char_bramvex.title: Bramvex — The Quiet Command
char_bramvex.subtitle: First Ten
char_bramvex.body:
MIL-006 · Homeland: Thornmarch · Knack: Camouflage / Sensory Adaptation.

A sergeant, not a legend. Captured, he observed for nineteen days, escaped on the twentieth, freed seventeen detainees — and occupied a Habitat wing until most of his demands quietly became policy.

His thorned weapon is called Diplomacy.

char_nerit.title: Nerit — The Lumen Weaver
char_nerit.subtitle: First Ten
char_nerit.body:
LUX-031 · Homeland: The Lumen Depths · Knack: Light Relocation / Darkness Manipulation.

In Nerit's culture darkness can mean privacy, rest, mourning, protection. Nerit argues that darkness can be a right — an argument now shaping Terrarium privacy standards.

char_zephyr.title: Zephyr — The Nectar Seeker
char_zephyr.subtitle: First Ten
char_zephyr.body:
AER-009 · Homeland: The Briarwild · Knack: Motion / Pollination.

In the Briarwild a spoken promise is contract, reputation and identity. Zephyr loves loopholes and despises broken vows. Officially designated COOPERATIVE NON-DETAINED ENTITY. Someone changed it to CONSULTANT. No one admits doing it.

char_nyxaris.title: Nyxaris — The Frostbloom Weaver
char_nyxaris.subtitle: First Ten
char_nyxaris.body:
CRYO-022 · Homeland: Frostbloom · Knack: Cryogenic Silk / Venom.

Her silk patterns encode authorship, warning and family history. Helix Industries called it secretion and patented an imitation. Nyxaris asked: Who gave you permission? Nyxaris v. Helix is still before the courts.

char_pharilux.title: Pharilux — The Watcher Below
char_pharilux.subtitle: First Ten
char_pharilux.body:
Designation: UNKNOWN · Homeland: Unknown.

A custodian of thresholds: shores, ruins, places where histories meet. An authenticated photograph from 1897 appears to show him beside lighthouse keepers. Shown modern Gate technology, he said: "You finally rebuilt it."

char_solmara.title: Solmara — The Tide Balancer
char_solmara.subtitle: First Ten
char_solmara.body:
TID-001 · Homeland: The Pelagic Expanse · Knack: Solar / Lunar / Tidal / Gravitational.

Solmara's people experience astronomy through the body before mathematics. On first seeing Earth's Moon, Solmara asked: "Who moved it?"

char_scarlith.title: Scarlith — The Fermented Kingpin
char_scarlith.subtitle: First Ten
char_scarlith.body:
MYC-013 · Homeland: The Velvet Warrens · Knack: Fermentation / Decomposition / Cultivation.

Twelve centimeters tall. One of the Undermarket's most capable brokers. "Value begins where neglect ends — but neglect must be real."

place_terrarium_one.title: Terrarium One
place_terrarium_one.body:
It began as a secure Gate complex. Every new Habitat added machinery; then the environments began interacting. Spores entered ventilation. A maintenance corridor became a market.

It stopped being a laboratory containing ecosystems. It became an ecosystem containing laboratories.

place_the_common.title: The Common
place_the_common.body: The first genuinely mixed district. No architect designed it. At its center stands the Common Table, built from discarded Habitat material. Nobody officially owns it.

place_red_reaches.title: The Red Reaches
place_red_reaches.body: Plateaus, mineral deserts and enormous fracture valleys. Settlements survive because generations maintain bridges, wells and roads. Reach culture is built on carried weight: strength is the burden you can accept without forcing it onto someone weaker.

place_ochre_span.title: The Ochre Span
place_ochre_span.body: A Spanwright crossing older than anyone's records, built in the same tradition as the Red Span. Every keystone carries the next.

place_gate.title: Scale Transition Array (the Gate)
place_gate.body: A Gate forces matter into a stable relationship with another scale-state. Earth is S0. Critter is S−1. "Shrinking" is convenient slang and scientifically incomplete.

old_roads.title: The Old Roads
old_roads.body:
Ruined causeways. Abandoned migration tunnels. Stone markers whose symbols appear continents apart. Dead trade languages.

They do not prove a lost global empire. They prove that Critter's civilizations have risen, connected, fragmented and forgotten one another many times.

lore_tilt.title: Scale Sickness — the Tilt
lore_tilt.body: Crossing is physically stressful: vertigo, distorted depth perception, phantom changes in body size, auditory delay. Handlers call the first minutes after a rough transition the Tilt.

lore_knacks.title: Knacks
lore_knacks.body: A Knack is the human term for an extraordinary biological capability. Knacks are not a universal magic system. They have mechanisms, and they have costs: heat, minerals, hydration, neural stability, time.

lore_capture_law.title: Capture Law
lore_capture_law.body:
Wild Containment — dangerous nonsapient organisms.
Protective Extraction — rescue, medicine, ecological crisis.
Contract Bonding — voluntary partnership between a sapient Critter and a Handler.
Diplomatic Transit — sapient travelers crossing independently.
Criminal Extraction — trafficking.

The technology looks similar. The meaning is completely different.

lore_habitats.title: Habitats
lore_habitats.body: A captured organism cannot simply be caged. It needs pieces of home: soil chemistry, microbes, humidity, light cycle, pressure, food web, symbionts and a tuned Scale Anchor. Habitats are medical infrastructure.

lore_burden_architecture.title: Burden Architecture
lore_burden_architecture.body: Aruun's engineering school: design structures around distributed failure. If one section breaks, the rest survives. "A structure should sacrifice itself before it sacrifices the people inside it."

lore_human_schism.title: The Human Schism
lore_human_schism.body:
The Stewardship Coalition: Access does not create ownership.
The Human Dominion: A frontier ignored is a frontier surrendered.

Neither is a government. Their beliefs cut through every institution.

mystery_thoughtstone.title: Thoughtstone
mystery_thoughtstone.subtitle: OPEN
mystery_thoughtstone.body:
Grows around deep subterranean biological-mineral networks. Most appears inert. Rare pieces respond to neural activity. Samples near Morrow align their internal structure toward it.

Is it mineral, organism, network, memory medium — or something without a human category?

mystery_eightfold.title: The Eightfold Paradox
mystery_eightfold.subtitle: OPEN
mystery_eightfold.body: How can a world entered by descending in scale contain more internal space than the world from which the traveler descended? Critter is roughly eight times Earth's size. Several models compete. None is confirmed.

mystery_pharilux_1897.title: The 1897 Problem
mystery_pharilux_1897.subtitle: OPEN
mystery_pharilux_1897.body: An authenticated Earth photograph, predating modern Quantum Descent, appears to show Pharilux beside lighthouse keepers. The markings match. The damaged lens matches.

mystery_moon.title: The Moon Question
mystery_moon.subtitle: OPEN
mystery_moon.body: Solmara: the Moon is not in the wrong orbit. The relationship feels displaced. Earth's gravitational pattern contains a missing return. No instrument has yet detected what that means.

place_echo_hollow.title: Echo Hollow
place_echo_hollow.subtitle: Red Reaches
place_echo_hollow.body: A dry side-cut off the Fracture Valley. The glyph wall answers speakers in their own voice, half a second late. Spanwright maintenance marks, left for strangers.

place_drovers_rest.title: Drover's Rest
place_drovers_rest.subtitle: Red Reaches
place_drovers_rest.body: The north spur from the Waystation. Cart ruts, a stalled wagon and a drover who prefers to carry his own weight until someone offers to share it.

place_salt_pans.title: The Salt Pans
place_salt_pans.subtitle: Red Reaches
place_salt_pans.body: White flats south of the Waystation. An old well still works if someone keeps patching it, and the crust preserves things that should not have lasted.

place_thought_vault.title: The Thoughtstone Vault
place_thought_vault.subtitle: Red Reaches
place_thought_vault.body: A sealed Spanwright vault off the Boulder Pass. The pulse-lock still turns. Closed is still working.

place_cistern.title: The Drowned Cistern
place_cistern.subtitle: Red Reaches
place_cistern.body: A hidden cleft behind the survey camp. Cold, still, dark. Something sleeps below the water and does not owe anyone a look.

place_overlook.title: Spanwright Overlook
place_overlook.subtitle: Red Reaches
place_overlook.body: A ledge above the Ochre Span. Past crews scratched load limits into the rail, and a cairn marks each crew that crossed.

place_red_span_remnant.title: The Red Span Remnant
place_red_span_remnant.subtitle: Red Reaches
place_red_span_remnant.body:
The broken stumps of the bridge that failed. Locals walk around it in silence.

THOUSANDS CROSSED. HUNDREDS DID NOT. A cairn of names stands beside it; one flat stone is left blank on purpose.

place_spanwright_yard.title: The Spanwright Yard
place_spanwright_yard.subtitle: Red Reaches
place_spanwright_yard.body:
A stone workshop cut into the plateau, where apprentices learn to be unnoticed.

MASTER'S RULE: Infrastructure succeeds when people stop noticing the danger it protects them from.

NOTE: Every yard keeps a book of the names it has mended for. Not every yard admits it.

place_well_line.title: The Well Line
place_well_line.subtitle: Red Reaches
place_well_line.body:
A chain of hand-cranked wells strung across the dry flats, kept for sixteen generations by the Keth families.

TALLY KNOTS: Each cup carried away is a knot on the crank cord. None are ever crossed out.

place_grazer_flats.title: The Grazer Flats
place_grazer_flats.subtitle: Red Reaches
place_grazer_flats.body:
Lichen terraces and herd trails that hold the plateau together.

FIELD NOTE: A herd feeds in a wedge. One sentinel watches the horizon and drops its head when the herd is safe.

place_augur_pit.title: The AUGUR Pit
place_augur_pit.subtitle: Red Reaches
place_augur_pit.body:
The deepcore rig's crater, ringed with pylons and quiet beetles.

PERMIT 7-K: Allows resonance up to forty percent of load. The Ochre Span tolerates twenty.

place_waystation.title: The Waystation
place_waystation.subtitle: Red Reaches
place_waystation.body:
A Spanwright waystation: wells, shade, and a place to mend rope. Paths lead off in every direction.

SIGN: 'Mend before you take.'

place_boulder_pass.title: The Boulder Pass
place_boulder_pass.subtitle: Red Reaches
place_boulder_pass.body:
A fracture-valley neck choked with a wedged boulder of cracked Thoughtstone. Heavy hands shatter it; careful ones read where it will fall.

A sealed Spanwright vault waits north of the pass.

lore_load_marks.title: Load Marks
lore_load_marks.subtitle: Spanwrights
lore_load_marks.body:
Cut into the rail of every Spanwright crossing: one mark for every crowd the bridge has been asked to carry.

The oldest marks are worn smooth. The newest are cut small, and slightly crooked, by apprentices who were told not to sign them.

lore_keth_tally.title: The Keth Tally
lore_keth_tally.subtitle: Red Reaches
lore_keth_tally.body:
Sixteen generations of Keths have counted every cup drawn from the Well Line, though they say water belongs to nobody.

The knots are not a debt. They are a record that the water was shared.

lore_permit_7k.title: Permit 7-K
lore_permit_7k.subtitle: Human Dominion
lore_permit_7k.body:
The Dominion extraction permit that licenses the AUGUR-7 rig. Section nine, the homeland clause, exempts local residents from survey restrictions. Appendix C lists exemptions for wildlife herds.

NOTE: Clerks write most of the clauses nobody reads. Some of them write them on purpose.
